newsitem.title: USA: Matav Cable buys stake in R.P Telekom.
newsitem.headline: Matav Cable buys stake in R.P Telekom.

text.p: Matav-Cable Systems Media Ltd of Israel said Monday it has signed an agreement with Trefoil Capital Investors LP and Shamrock Holdings Inc to buy all of Trefoil's shares in R.P. Telekom S.A.

R.P. Telekom is owned by a group of American, Israeli and Polish investors and holds licenses to build telecommunications systems in Poland and a license to operate radio trunking services in that country.
Under the agreement, Matav will buy 20 percent of Telekom held by Trefoil, or 1,571,163 shares, at $17.50 a share, for a total of $27.495 million.
MATAV said it has also agreed to guarantee an estimated $19 million in obligations of Telekom towards third parties.
The agreement should close October 25, the company said.
Matav operates and provides broadband cable TV in Israel and has exclusive franchises covering about 25 percent of Israel's households.

The company said Trefoil is a Delaware-incorporated limited partnership. Shamrock Holdings Inc is a limited partner in Trefoil. Dankner Investments Ltd, which owns about 16 percent of Matav, holds about 23 percent of R.P. Telekom.
